chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Blessed is the one who submits [to God] and whose livelihood is at the level of subsistence.'

key_terms.كَفَافاً: At the level of subsistence / sufficient

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Toba in the hadith about subsistence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Shia virtue of Qana'ah (contentment), linking spiritual salvation to a lifestyle of modest sufficiency rather than material accumulation. It reflects the broader theological emphasis on detaching from worldly excess to maintain focus on divine remembrance, a concept deeply rooted in the lives of the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Toba’ (a Blessed tree in Paradise) is for the one becomes a Muslim and his life was at subsistence level’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Tuba (a tree in paradise) is for those who have become Muslims and whose expenses are within the limits of bare necessities.”
